title: Retain full-launch ambiguity when changed descriptions or repeated starts retire its check
outcome: Retiring a full-launch check on a changed description or repeated start retains enough run association history to prevent later gates borrowing its run.
acceptance: Preserve the original full launch root/start ambiguity marker when a changed command or place removes its open check, including repeated-start replacement.
Cover the ACP terminal describe-before-complete ordering and repeated-start change through later carry and settlement, with matched positive controls.
Focused validation, final full gate and independent review cover the final input.
